name: Rough.js
tagline: Makes shapes and charts look sketched by hand, with pencil-style shading. It gives the popular whiteboard app Excalidraw its look.
author: Preet Shihn
settled: Finished, not abandoned: last push July 2024, but 15 million npm downloads a week (week to 26 Oct 2026), and Mermaid and Excalidraw both depend on it. Reviewed 2026-10-28.
